summary: stdcall helper that obtains a pointer to a 0x18-byte (6-DWORD) block by calling sub_59942B(-1) and bulk-copies those 24 bytes into the caller-supplied destination a1, returning a1. The remaining parameters (a2..a8) are declared in the prototype but unused in the body.

operations.description: Obtain the source block: v8 = sub_59942B(-1); the sentinel argument -1 selects the shared/global source buffer.
result = a1 keeps the destination pointer so it can be returned.
qmemcpy(a1, v8, 0x18u): copy 24 bytes (6 DWORDs) from the source block into a1.

unresolved: What sub_59942B(-1) returns (which 0x18-byte global data block) is not established by this packet.
Parameters a2..a8 are unused; their intended meaning is unknown.
